d:
Chhath par ghar jane vale bihar aur purvanchal ke logon ke lie dilli aur bihar sarkar ne 77 basen shuru ki hain. aanand vihar se bihar ke panch mandlon ke lie chalne vali in bason ke kiraye men yatriyon ko chhut milegi. janie kin shahron ke lie kitni basen chalengi aur saphar men kya suvidhaen milengi.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
